# Gravita Ground Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

> Built Below. Engineered Beyond. Specialist ground engineering, evolved from Mother Earth Movers and Infra Pvt. Ltd.

## Pages
- [Built Below. Engineered Beyond.](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/): Specialist ground engineering: secant piling, diaphragm walls, strutting, excavation and dewatering. Explore Gravita’s execution heritage and discuss your project.
- [Specialist ground engineering expertise](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/services/): Explore Gravita’s five connected disciplines for deep excavation, earth retention, basement construction and groundwater management.
- [Secant piling for complex ground conditions](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/services/secant-piling/): Intersecting bored piles form a retaining wall for constrained excavations. Secant piling brings earth retention and groundwater-control considerations into one coordinated design conversation.
- [Diaphragm walls for complex ground conditions](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/services/diaphragm-walls/): Diaphragm walls are reinforced concrete walls formed in excavated panels. They can support deep basement and infrastructure excavations, with the final role defined by project-specific design.
- [Strutting for complex ground conditions](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/services/strutting/): A coordinated strutting system supports retaining walls through successive excavation stages. Its layout must reconcile structural demands with equipment access, excavation logistics and permanent works.
- [Excavation for complex ground conditions](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/services/excavation/): Deep excavation is an orchestrated construction activity. Ground conditions, surrounding assets, retaining systems, fleet movement and material removal must be planned together.
- [Dewatering for complex ground conditions](https://gravita-ground-engineering.aristoverse.chatgpt.site/services/dewatering/): Dewatering addresses groundwater within and around an excavation. System selection needs an understanding of the soil, water regime, surrounding assets and approved discharge arrangements.
